seal.statement: A failure bundle records, for each retained node-log window, its coverage of the failure window (first divergence to the end of the run) and the byte count it withheld, and a bundle whose coverage is partial is published as incomplete: the scenario verdict for it is non-measuring with the withheld bytes named, never a dominant reason derived from the retained tail; the LOG_TAIL_LINE_COUNT writer in test/distributed/harness/failure-bundle-artifact-foundation.js gains that coverage record or is replaced by retention bounded in bytes from the first divergence.
